text: {Job's Suffering is Grave} d In rebuttal, Job replied:
"If only my grief could be weighed; or my calamity piled together on a balance scale!
It would weigh more than the sand on the seashore! {Lit. sea} Here's why I've talked so rashly:
"The arrows of the Almighty have pierced me; my spirit absorbs {Lit. drinks} their poison; {Lit. heat} God's terrors have been arranged just for me!
"Will the wild donkey bray from hunger {The Heb. lacks from hunger} if fresh grass is beside him? Will the ox low from distress {The Heb. lacks from distress} if it is near its feed?
Tasteless food isn't eaten without salt, is it? Is there any taste in an egg white?
I cannot bring myself to touch them; {The Heb. lacks them} food like this makes me sick."
{Job Desires Death} d "Who will grant my wish? {Or Oh, that I might have my request;} I wish God would grant what I'm hoping for:
that God would just be willing {Lit. pleased} to crush me; that he would let loose {Lit. loose his hand} and eliminate me!
At least I could still take comfort and rejoice in unceasing anguish, for I didn't conceal what the Holy One has to say.
"Do I have the strength to wait? And why {Lit. And to what end} should I be patient?
Am I as strong as a rock? Am I some kind of iron man? {Lit. Is my flesh bronze?}
There is no help within me, is there? My resources have been driven away from me, haven't they?
{Job Accuses His Friends of Treachery} d The friend shows gracious love for his friend, even if he has forsaken the fear of the Almighty.
But my brothers have acted treacherously like a cascading river, like torrential rivers that overflow.
Filled with waters made cold {Lit. dark} by ice, they are where the snow goes to hide.
But then the snow melts, and they disappear; when warmed, they evaporate from their stream beds. {Lit. their place}
Travelers divert {Lit. twist} in their route; they go into a wasteland and die.
Travelers from Tema search intently; caravans from Sheba hope to find them.
For all their expectations, they are doomed to disappointment; even though they have come and searched this far.
"And now you're all just like them, aren't you? {Lit. it} You see my terror and are terrified.
When did I ever ask you for anything, say «Offer a bribe for me from your wealth? '
or say «Deliver me from my enemy's control,'{Lit. hand} or «Redeem me from the domination {Lit. hand} of ruthless people'?"
{Job Requests Mercy from His Friends} d "Instruct me, and I'll remain silent. Help me understand where I've gone astray.
The truth {Lit. Upright words} can be painful, but what has your argument proven?
Did you intend your words to reprove, even though the speech of a desperate person is just wind?
Indeed, you would gamble to buy an orphan; and barter to buy your friend!
Now be willing to face me, and I won't lie to your face.
Repent! Let there be no injustice; Change your ways! {The Heb. lacks your ways} My vindication {Or righteousness} is at stake.
Have I said anything that's unjust? I can discern {Lit. taste} evil, can't I?"
